structured_output.what_is_happening: A token called "币安中秋" ("Binance Mid-Autumn") had a PumpSwap pool created about 12 minutes before detection, apparently set up directly rather than through a finished pump.fun bonding curve (migrated_unix=0, deploy platform unknown). It rose about 205–235% on roughly $250k of volume at a ~$46–50k market cap. Unique buyers (1,064) far outnumber unique sellers (52). The creator wallet holds 15.95% and GMGN tags it as a rat trader (an insider wallet). 100% of the LP is unlocked. I found no socials, website or DexScreener profile. At least 10 other tokens with the same name have been launched in the past ~24h. One of them, 7yyJ..., did $1.56M of volume in its first hour, about 1.6h before this one.

narrative.description: A Binance plus Mid-Autumn Festival themed Chinese meme. The festival was 2026-09-25, so it is one day past. I could not verify any Binance campaign or news that would give this token a specific reason to exist.
narrative.why_spreading: It seems to be part of an ongoing wave of Chinese-name 'Binance' memes, with repeated copies of the same name. Trading attention is rotating between copies, not coming from a real event that is growing.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is simply the newest copy with momentum right now. It has no socials or claim to be the original.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are at least 10 same-name tokens. 7yyJmNaZ... had $1.56M in h1 volume and was created about 1.6h earlier. pgniPm..., created about 17h earlier, shows a bogus $227M market cap with no liquidity. Several others have died at $30–320k.

authenticity.evidence: Buyers outnumber sellers 1,064 to 52, which could mean real retail FOMO or scripted buying. GMGN shows 0 snipers and 0 bundlers but a 16.6% fresh-wallet rate. The creator (a rat-trader wallet) holds 16% and controls unlocked LP. GeckoTerminal counts only 237 holders, with the top 10 at 93% (including the pool). There is no paid promotion.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, and search engines returned nothing for the contract address, so the real social spread is unknown.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked in a pool the creator seeded directly, so it can be pulled at any time
The creator holds 15.95% and is flagged as a rat trader
Many copycats with the same name split demand
It has already pumped more than 200% in 12 minutes, so entry is near the local top

structured_output.counterargument: Momentum is extreme: 529 buys in 5 minutes and h1 turnover of 4.5x. A sister copy just did $1.5M/h, which shows the name is hot with Chinese-meme traders. Liquidity close to the market cap means the price moves less per dollar traded, but it also means sellers get fair exits. It could still double to about $100k mcap if this copy becomes the 'next' one traders rotate into.
unknowns: Whether the creator will pull the unlocked LP

Whether a real Binance Mid-Autumn event is driving interest

source_coverage.notes: Time was limited. A contract search and Chinese-language name searches found nothing relevant, and the packet lists no socials.

structured_output.thesis: This is a late copy of a Binance Mid-Autumn meme that has already been cloned many times, launched a day after the festival. The creator controls unlocked LP and holds 16%. The price is already up more than 200% before entry. The chance of doubling is below the pool average and the rug risk is high.
